decisions.question: S06 suggests an optional hsdd-adr touch that adds topic-model@v1 to ADR-003's affects, so the contract header could carry Governed by ADR-003. Run it?

options.label: Run the hsdd-adr touch
options.consequence: One more step; hsdd-config would inject ADR-003's Decision into every phase that consumes topic-model@v1, which is nearly every phase of the tree.

options.label: Leave affects as it is
options.consequence: ADR-003 keeps governing nidana.model, the producer, so the producer's phases still receive it; the contract carries the obligation as its own guarantee G25 and cites ADR-003 item 8 in prose.

decisions.why: The obligation ADR-003 puts on this contract (no clock, no scheduling, timestamps and ids as arguments) binds the producer, which ADR-003 already governs, and the contract states it as G25. Injecting ADR-003 into every consumer's phase context would add a long Decision to phases it does not constrain. The signal that would change this: a consumer-side obligation from ADR-003 on topic-model values.
